subject: Re: Inbound request — bootcamp resource grant & trial extension
messages:
--- Message 1: 2027-04-25 09:12:00 - From: Soma Patel <soma@voltaic.ai> - To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com - Subject: Inquiry: Bootcamp resources & trial extension

Hi Lauren,

We're running the Voltaic Winter Bootcamp (cohort of 12 early-stage startups) from May 10 - June 21. We try to give each team enough inference credits to build an MVP during the program. Last year we used multiple providers; this year we'd love to give Redwood a featured slot.

Two asks:
- Promotional credits: can Redwood provide a cohort credit pool (roughly $12k-$18k in net credits) that we can allocate across teams?
- Trial extension: several startups hit the free trial limit; can you extend trial windows for the cohort so they can finish integration work over the 6 weeks?

Attached is a short one-pager about the program and rough usage projections. Happy to jump on a quick call.

Thanks,
Soma Patel
Head of Partnerships, Voltaic.ai
Soma | +1 (415) 555-0132
Attachments: startup_one_pager.pdf (application/ pdf)

--- Message 2: 2027-04-26 10:05:00 - From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com - To: Soma Patel <soma@voltaic.ai> - Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com - Subject: Re: Inquiry: Bootcamp resources & trial extension

Hi Soma — great to hear from you and congrats on the cohort lineup.

Short answer: we can support cohort-level promotional credits and a limited trial-extension program, but we need to confirm a couple of qualification details before approving. Can you confirm:
- Are the 12 teams incorporated/startups (we prioritize registered entities for credit grants)?
- Will teams sign the standard Redwood trial terms / attest to non-production use during the bootcamp?
- Expected aggregate monthly token volume across the cohort (your spreadsheet hints at ~2M tokens/mo).

If that checks out, I can propose a pilot grant: $15k in credits scoped to the cohort + two-week trial extensions for teams that complete our onboarding checklist. We'll also want a co-branded case study clause (opt-in).

Would you be available for a 30-min call on Tue (4/27) or Wed (4/28)?

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Startup Programs | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0104

--- Message 3 (internal): 2027-04-26 14:18:00 - From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com - To: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com - Subject: Voltaic bootcamp — credit ask / approval path (internal)

Team — copying the notes from my reply to Soma and attaching their projections. Quick ask: can we greenlight a cohort credit of $15k (net credits applied to accounts) with the following guardrails?

Proposed guardrails: 
- Eligibility: teams must be part of Voltaic's curated cohort and sign our trial extension form (non-production attest).
- Allocation: Redwood issues one pooled credit allocation to Voltaic; they assign to teams by email. Unused credits expire 90 days after issue.
- Trial extension: +14 days added to standard trial for qualifying teams (no extra billing).
- Case study: opt-in, Redwood retains rights to publish aggregated usage and a short blurb post-program.
- Risk control: cap per-team allocation at $3,000 unless pre-approved by Sales (to limit exposure).

Operational asks:
- Ben: confirm we can set an account-level promo code or pooled credit (HubSpot / billing changes) and that finance can accept the 90-day expiry.
- Marissa: if we do this, please draft the short terms (trial-extension agreement) and an email template the cohort manager can use to assign credits.

Attachments: usage_projections.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Notes: If finance pushes back on pooled credits, fallback is to issue individual credits to each startup that signs our onboarding form.

Thanks — LM

--- Message 4: 2027-05-04 11:20:00 - From: Soma Patel <soma@voltaic.ai> - To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com - Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena@byteforge.com> - Subject: Re: Inbound request — bootcamp resources & trial extension

Lauren / Team,

This looks good — Voltaic confirms all 12 teams are registered entities (we'll share company names next day). They accept the $15k cohort allocation and the +14 day trial extension with the per-team cap as described.

Next steps for us:
1) Voltaic will send the roster + contact emails for each startup by 5/6.
2) Please share the trial-extension form and the allocation email template.
3) Schedule a 30-min onboarding call for May 9 (we propose 10am PT).

Thanks for moving quickly on this. Looking forward to partnering.

— Soma
